evidence.qualification: Repeated exit events are a lead for configuration review, not proof of a defective button.

evidence.qualification: The general observation is useful elsewhere, but product dimensions and repair procedures are not transferred.

evidence.claim: Net2 defines left-open by an authorised opening exceeding its allowance, and forced-open by an opening without a recognised release.

sourceRefs.section: Alarm definitions; Alarm types; Alarm reporting at the PC; Exit-button behaviour

evidence.qualification: Alarm labels do not establish intent or prove unlawful entry.

evidence.claim: Both Net2 door alarms depend on the monitored door contact.
evidence.qualification: A disagreement with visible position is an editorial fault lead, not a component diagnosis.

evidence.claim: Hikvision separates unreachable address/path errors, authentication errors and a camera-not-detected message.
evidence.qualification: Password recovery, defaulting and network changes in the source are not included.

evidence.claim: Supported Hik-Partner Pro switches can report a PoE-port-power-off exception.
evidence.qualification: The cause is an inference combining the recorded power exception with missing-camera status.

evidence.claim: Shared switches and available throughput can affect multiple video streams.
evidence.qualification: Shared timing is suggestive, not proof of a failed switch.

evidence.claim: Hikvision lists schedule, motion-event configuration and HDD exception as distinct recording-failure reasons.
evidence.qualification: Live video alone does not prove past recording; formatting instructions in the source are excluded.

evidence.claim: Axis describes time-limited retention, possible early deletion when full, and a reported oldest-recording timestamp.

evidence.qualification: No recovery guarantee or instruction to modify retention is made.

evidence.claim: Axis reports camera/server time differences and timestamp consequences.

sourceRefs.section: Detected time difference on a device

evidence.qualification: Searching the wrong apparent time is an editorial inference; clocks are not changed.

evidence.qualification: No nearby reflector in a picture does not exclude IR reflection.
